items.title: Jensen Huang's Nvidia comeback: Why the math doesn't add up
items.summary: Tamalpais Strategies Founder and Principal, Jim Prosser, joins Deirdre Bosa on Deirdre Bosa Live to discuss what it will actually take to bring Jensen Huang back as Nvidia (NVDA) CEO. Although "vibes" may be high, Huang's comeback does add up.

items.title: Nvidia will not be the leader 5 years from now: Tiernan Ray
items.summary:
The Technology Letter's Tiernan Ray joins Market Hang to discuss why Nvidia (NVDA) will not be the leader of the AI chip race in 5 years.

Today's panel includes Barron's reporter Jacob Sonenshine, The Technology Letter's Tiernan Ray, Epistrophy Capital Research Chief Market Strategist Cory Johnson, and Laffer Tengler Investments CEO and chief investment officer Nancy Tengler.

items.title: Why AI competition from China won't be a risk US tech companies
items.summary:
Host Mark Malek, Siebert Financial's chief investment officer, and his panel of experts weigh in on whether competition from China is a risk to US tech companies.

Today's panel includes Barron's reporter Jacob Sonenshine, The Technology Letter's Tiernan Ray, Epistrophy Capital Research Chief Market Strategist Cory Johnson, and Laffer Tengler Investments CEO and chief investment officer Nancy Tengler.

items.title: Anthropic's mega-IPO is still leaving investors working with 'imperfect information'
items.summary: Following Anthropic's (ANT) historic mega-IPO, Baird managing director of technology Ted Mortonson comes on Yahoo Finance to discuss the information that investors are currently working with when it comes to the AI company's compute spending.

items.title: Being bearish on Anthropic: $1 trillion compute bill and Nvidia turmoil
items.summary: In the Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen lays out the case against Anthropic's (ANT) roughly $1 trillion compute commitment, arguing that Nvidia's (NVDA) leadership turmoil and a possible slowdown in US data center build-out could cut into its GPU supply and revenue.

items.title: AI expert Gary Marcus weighs in on recent tech outages
items.summary:
Scientist, Entrepreneur & Author "Taming Silicon Valley: How We Can Ensure That AI Works for Us" Gary Marcus joins Yahoo Finance's special coverage of Anthropic's (ANT) IPO to discuss AI's role in a series of recent technology outages.

"It's all AI, but it's not one thing," Marcus says, highlighting the complexity of artificial intelligence and the importance of distinguishing between different AI technologies when examining system failures.

items.title: Anthropic soars in record Wall Street debut
items.summary: Anthropic shares closed 17 percent higher in their record Nasdaq debut on Thursday, defying a broad Wall Street sell-off as investors shrugged off the Nvidia spy scandal and fears of a tech bubble to back the AI giant.The gain came on a rough day for the market, with both the tech-heavy Nasdaq and the broader S&P 500 closing down more than two percent.

items.title: Nvidia vs. Intel: One AI Stock Is Worth the Drama, the Other Isn’t Worth the Wait, Says Investor
items.summary: For a while, the only thing Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) and Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) had in common was that they both made chips. Nvidia rode the AI boom to become one of the world’s most valuable companies, while Intel spent years trying to repair its business. Now they share a problem: shareholders who aren’t sure what comes next.
